Description:
An opportunistic predator, this eel derives it's name from the sheer amount present in Cursed Waters. As the waters turn sour its primal instincts take over.

Special:

 Cooking

This rare and tasty fish is an important ingredient in several Midnight Cooking recipes.

- The Coiled Isle

Rates:
- This fish is only found in the Cursed Waters after a Venom Surge in The Coiled Isle.
